We may receive compensation when you click on links to those products or services. The top-ranked Duke Blue Devils and the No. 7 UConn Huskies are set to meet in a significant postseason clash. Duke enters the game holding the number one spot in the AP Top 25 with a 32-2 overall record. UConn sits at number seven with a 29-5 mark. Both programs are rolling through postseason play. Duke holds a 3-0 record representing the Atlantic Coast Conference. UConn matches that with a 3-0 mark for the Big East. Watch Duke vs UConn on Paramount+. This guide provides all the necessary details for fans wanting to follow the action. Read on to find the exact tip-off time, the venue location in Washington, DC, and the television channels and live streaming options available to watch the Blue Devils take on the Huskies. When Is Duke vs UConn? What Time Does It Start? The postseason matchup between the Duke Blue Devils and the UConn Huskies is scheduled for March 29, 2026. Tip-off is set for 5:05 PM ET. Where Is Duke vs UConn? This postseason matchup takes place at Capital One Arena in Washington, DC. As a neutral site game, the event is held away from both campuses. For the purposes of this contest, the Duke Blue Devils are designated as the home team. The UConn Huskies serve as the away team. How Can I Watch Duke vs UConn? Fans looking to watch the matchup between the Duke Blue Devils and the UConn Huskies can find the live television broadcast on CBS. The network will carry the game live as the teams tip off at 5:05 PM ET. How Can I Stream Duke vs UConn? Fans looking to stream the game have a direct option through the broadcast network’s own platform. CBS offers its live sports programming on its branded streaming service, Paramount+. This platform will host the live internet broadcast of the matchup. In addition to Paramount+, there are other streaming alternatives that carry CBS. Viewers can also stream the game on FuboTV and Sling as the Huskies and Blue Devils tip off at 5:05 PM ET.
